50 Οὐκ ἐξουδενώσεις τὴν ἀδελφήν σου ἐσθίουσαν καὶ ἐπὶ ἐγκρατείᾳ σου μὴ
ἐπαρθῇς. οὐ γὰρ οἶδας, τί βεβούλευται ὁ κύριος ἢ τίς στήσεται ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ.
51 Ἡ οἰκτείρουσα πελιδνουμένους τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς καὶ τηκομένας τὰς
σάρκας αὐτῆς, οὐκ εὐφρανθήσεται ἐπὶ ἀπαθείᾳ ψυχῆς.
52 Βαρεῖα ἐγκράτεια καὶ δυσκατόρθωτος ἁγνεία, ἀλλ' οὐδὲν γλυκύτερον τοῦ
ἐπουρανίου νυμφίου.
53 Ψυχαὶ παρθένων φωτισθήσονται, ψυχαὶ δὲ ἀκαθάρτων ὄψονται σκότος.
2
54 Εἶδον ἄνδρας φθείροντας παρθένους ἐν δόγμασι καὶ ματαίαν ποιοῦντας
τὴν παρθενείαν αὐτῶν. σὺ δὲ ἄκουε, τέκνον, δογμάτων ἐκκλησίας κυρίου, καὶ μηδεὶς
ἀλλότριος μεταπείσῃ σε. δίκαιοι γὰρ κληρονομήσουσι φῶς, ἀσεβεῖς δὲ οἰκήσουσι
σκότος.
55 Παρθένοι ὀφθαλμοὶ ὄψονται κύριον. ἀκοαὶ δὲ παρθένων ἀκούσονται
λόγων αὐτοῦ. παρθένων στόμα φιλήσει νυμφίον αὐτοῦ. ὄσφρησις δὲ παρθένων ἐπ'
ὀσμὴν μύρων αὐτοῦ δραμεῖται. χεῖρες παρθένοι ψηλαφήσουσι κύριον, καὶ ἁγνεία
σαρκὸς εὐπρόσδεκτος ἔσται. παρθένος ψυχὴ στεφανωθήσεται, καὶ μετὰ τοῦ νυμφίου
αὐτῆς βιώσεται διὰ παντός. ἔνδυμα πνευματικὸν δοθήσεται αὐτῇ, καὶ μετὰ ἀγγέλων
ἐν οὐρανοῖς ἑορτάσει. ἄσβεστον ἀνάψει λαμπάδα, καὶ ἔλαιον οὐ λείψει ἐν τοῖς
ἀγγείοις αὐτῆς. λήψεται πλοῦτον αἰώνιον, καὶ κληρονομήσει βασιλείαν τὴν τοῦ
θεοῦ.
56 Οἱ ἐμοὶ λόγοι, τέκνον, εἴρηνται πρός σε, τὰ δὲ ἐμὰ ῥήματα τηρείτω σὴ
καρδία. μέμνησο Χριστοῦ τοῦ φυλάσσοντός σε, καὶ μὴ ἐπιλάθῃ τῆς προσκυνητῆς
τριάδος.

thought_title: Do not judge and the reward of a pure virgin
orientation: Evagrius closes his counsels to the virgin by contrasting pure and impure souls and charging her to keep his words and remember Christ and the Trinity.
pass_a_gloss: You will not despise your sister when she eats, and do not be lifted up over your self-control. For you do not know what the Lord has decided or who will stand before him. She who pities bruised eyes and her own melting flesh will not rejoice over freedom from passion of soul. Self-control is burdensome and purity is hard to accomplish, but nothing is sweeter than the heavenly bridegroom. Souls of virgins will be enlightened, but souls of impure people will see darkness. I saw men corrupting virgins by doctrines and making their virginity vain. But you, child, listen to doctrines of the church of the Lord, and let no stranger persuade you otherwise. For righteous people will inherit light, but impious people will dwell in darkness. Virgin eyes will see the Lord. And ears of virgins will hear his words. Mouth of virgins will kiss its bridegroom. And the sense of smell of virgins will run toward the scent of his ointments. Virgin hands will touch the Lord, and purity of flesh will be acceptable. A virgin soul will be crowned, and she will live with her bridegroom through all time. A spiritual garment will be given to her, and with angels in the heavens she will feast. She will kindle an unquenchable lamp, and oil will not fail in her vessels. She will receive eternal wealth, and she will inherit the kingdom of God. My words, child, have been spoken to you, and let your heart keep my sayings. Remember Christ who guards you, and do not forget the worshipful Trinity.

choices.why: brief glossary requires this exact rendering for bodily discipline
brief glossary requires this sense of bodily chastity
brief glossary requires this state of calm, not lack of feeling
brief identifies this as Christ the heavenly bridegroom
brief glossary fixes both terms for the virgin soul and mercy
brief glossary requires this for the holy Trinity

bible_refs.note: quoted source words: ἔλαιον ... ἐν τοῖς ἀγγείοις αὐτῆς

pass_b_english: Do not despise your sister when she eats, and do not become proud of your own self-control. You do not know what the Lord has decided or who will stand before him. She who feels pity for her bruised eyes and her wasting flesh will take no delight in freedom from passion in her soul. Self-control is a heavy burden and purity is hard to achieve, yet nothing is sweeter than the heavenly bridegroom.

The souls of virgins will be filled with light, but the souls of the impure will gaze on darkness. I have watched men corrupt virgins with false doctrines and make their virginity worthless. So listen, child, to the doctrines of the Church of the Lord, and let no stranger persuade you away from them. The righteous will inherit light, while the godless will dwell in darkness.

Virgin eyes will see the Lord. Virgin ears will hear his words. A virgin mouth will kiss her bridegroom. A virgin sense of smell will hasten after the fragrance of his ointments. Virgin hands will touch the Lord, and purity of flesh will be accepted. A virgin soul will be crowned and will live with her bridegroom forever.

She will receive a spiritual garment and will feast with the angels in heaven. She will kindle a lamp that cannot be quenched, and the oil in her jars will never fail (Matthew 25:4). She will obtain eternal wealth and will inherit the kingdom of God. Child, my words have now been spoken to you, so let your heart keep what I have said. Remember Christ, who guards you, and never forget the worshipful Trinity.

last_rejected.quote: and the oil in her jars will never fail (Matthew 25:4)
last_rejected.source_quote: καὶ ἔλαιον οὐ λείψει ἐν τοῖς ἀγγείοις αὐτῆς
last_rejected.why: Matt 25:4 is the wise taking oil in vessels, not oil that never runs out.
last_rejected.fix: and the oil in her jars will never fail.
last_rejected.ruling: Matt 25:4 is the exact source of the virgin-parable allusion 'ἔλαιον ... ἐν τοῖς ἀγγείοις' with 'λαμπάδα'; citing it is accurate, not misleading.
